column2:
waist(n.)腰、腰部
(無詞性變化)
slim waist 纖細的腰
waist size 腰圍
She tied a belt around her waist.
(她在腰間繫了一條腰帶。)
The water came up to my waist.
(水淹到了我的腰部。)

waiter(n.)服務生、男服務生
waitress(n.)女服務生
wait(v.)等待、服侍
call the waiter 叫服務生
tip the waitress 給女服務生小費
The waiter brought us the menu.
(服務生拿菜單給我們。)
The waitress was very kind to us.
(那位女服務生對我們很親切。)

wallet(n.)皮夾、錢包
(無詞性變化)
lose a wallet 遺失皮夾
leather wallet 皮製錢包
I left my wallet at home.
(我把皮夾忘在家裡了。)
He found a wallet on the street.
(他在街上撿到一個錢包。)

war(n.)戰爭
warrior(n.)戰士
world war 世界大戰
at war 處於戰爭狀態
Many people died in the war.
(很多人死於那場戰爭。)
We all hope for a world without war.
(我們都希望有一個沒有戰爭的世界。)

wash(v./n.)洗、洗滌
washing(n.)洗滌、待洗衣物
washer(n.)洗衣機
wash the dishes 洗碗
wash your hands 洗手
Please wash your hands before dinner.
(晚餐前請洗手。)
It's my turn to wash the dishes.
(輪到我洗碗了。)

waste(n./v.)浪費、廢棄物
wasteful(adj.)浪費的
waste time 浪費時間
a waste of money 浪費錢
Don't waste your time on video games.
(別把時間浪費在電玩上。)
Buying that toy was a waste of money.
(買那個玩具真是浪費錢。)

watermelon(n.)西瓜
(無詞性變化)
watermelon juice 西瓜汁
a slice of watermelon 一片西瓜
Watermelon is my favorite summer fruit.
(西瓜是我最愛的夏季水果。)
We shared a big watermelon at the beach.
(我們在海邊分吃了一顆大西瓜。)

wealth(n.)財富、大量
wealthy(adj.)富有的
great wealth 巨大財富
a wealth of 大量的、豐富的
Health is more important than wealth.
(健康比財富更重要。)
The book has a wealth of information.
(這本書有豐富的資訊。)

wedding(n.)婚禮
wed(v.)結婚
wedding dress 婚紗
wedding ring 結婚戒指
My cousin's wedding is next Sunday.
(我表姊的婚禮在下週日。)
She looked beautiful in her wedding dress.
(她穿婚紗看起來很美。)

weekday(n.)平日、工作日
(無詞性變化)
on weekdays 在平日
weekday mornings 平日早上
I get up at six on weekdays.
(我平日六點起床。)
The museum is less crowded on weekdays.
(博物館平日比較不擁擠。)

weigh(v.)稱重、重達、權衡
weight(n.)重量
weigh oneself 量體重
weigh the pros and cons 權衡利弊
How much do you weigh?
(你體重多少？)
The baby weighs three kilograms.
(這個嬰兒重三公斤。)

weight(n.)重量、體重
weigh(v.)稱重、重達
lose weight 減重
gain weight 體重增加
He wants to lose weight before summer.
(他想在夏天前減重。)
The weight of the box is ten kilograms.
(這個箱子的重量是十公斤。)

western(adj./n.)西方的、西部的、西部片
west(n.)西方
Western culture 西方文化
western part 西部
She is interested in Western art.
(她對西方藝術很感興趣。)
The western part of Taiwan is very crowded.
(台灣西部人口很稠密。)

whale(n.)鯨魚
(無詞性變化)
whale watching 賞鯨
blue whale 藍鯨
We went whale watching in Hualien.
(我們到花蓮去賞鯨。)
The blue whale is the largest animal on earth.
(藍鯨是地球上最大的動物。)

whatever(adj./pron.)無論什麼、任何……的事物
(無詞性變化)
whatever happens 無論發生什麼事
whatever you like 任何你喜歡的
You can eat whatever you like.
(你喜歡吃什麼就吃什麼。)
Whatever happens, I will support you.
(無論發生什麼事，我都會支持你。)

wheel(n.)輪子、方向盤
(無詞性變化)
steering wheel 方向盤
behind the wheel 開車
One of the bike's wheels is broken.
(腳踏車的一個輪子壞了。)
Keep both hands on the steering wheel.
(雙手要握住方向盤。)

whenever(conj./adv.)每當、無論何時
(無詞性變化)
whenever possible 只要有可能
whenever you want 隨時
Whenever I feel sad, I listen to music.
(每當我難過時，我就聽音樂。)
Come and visit us whenever you want.
(你隨時都可以來找我們。)

wherever(adv./conj.)無論何處、在任何地方
(無詞性變化)
wherever you go 無論你去哪裡
wherever possible 盡可能
My dog follows me wherever I go.
(無論我去哪裡，我的狗都跟著我。)
You can sit wherever you like.
(你想坐哪裡都可以。)

whisper(n./v.)低語、耳語
(無詞性變化)
in a whisper 小聲地
whisper to sb. 對某人耳語
She whispered something in my ear.
(她在我耳邊低聲說了些話。)
They talked in a whisper in the library.
(他們在圖書館裡小聲交談。)

whoever(pron.)無論是誰、任何……的人
(無詞性變化)
whoever comes 無論誰來
whoever wins 無論誰贏
Whoever finishes first will get a prize.
(誰先完成就能得到獎品。)
You can invite whoever you like.
(你想邀請誰都可以。)

whole(adj./n.)整個的、全部的、整體
wholly(adv.)完全地
the whole day 一整天
as a whole 整體而言
I spent the whole day studying.
(我花了一整天讀書。)
He ate the whole pizza by himself.
(他一個人吃掉了整個披薩。)

whom(pron.)誰(受格)
(無詞性變化)
to whom 給誰
with whom 和誰
To whom should I send this letter?
(我應該把這封信寄給誰？)
The man whom you met is my uncle.
(你見到的那個人是我叔叔。)

width(n.)寬度
wide(adj.)寬的
widen(v.)加寬
the width of 的寬度
in width 寬度為
The road is ten meters in width.
(這條路寬十公尺。)
Measure the width of the window.
(量一下窗戶的寬度。)

wild(adj./adv./n.)野生的、狂野的、荒野
wildlife(n.)野生動物
wildly(adv.)瘋狂地
wild animals 野生動物
in the wild 在野外
Tigers live in the wild in Asia.
(老虎在亞洲的野外生活。)
The fans went wild after the goal.
(進球後球迷們都瘋狂了。)

willing(adj.)願意的、樂意的
willingness(n.)意願
unwilling(adj.)不願意的
be willing to 願意
willing helper 熱心的幫手
I am willing to help you.
(我很樂意幫你。)
Are you willing to try something new?
(你願意嘗試新事物嗎？)

windy(adj.)颳風的、風大的
wind(n.)風
windy day 颳風的日子
cold and windy 又冷風又大
It's too windy to fly a kite today.
(今天風太大，不能放風箏。)
Hsinchu is famous for its windy weather.
(新竹以風大聞名。)

wine(n.)葡萄酒、酒
(無詞性變化)
red wine 紅酒
a glass of wine 一杯葡萄酒
My parents had a glass of red wine.
(我爸媽喝了一杯紅酒。)
This wine is made from grapes.
(這種酒是用葡萄釀的。)

wing(n.)翅膀、機翼、側翼
winged(adj.)有翅膀的
spread its wings 展翅
chicken wings 雞翅
The bird spread its wings and flew away.
(那隻鳥展開翅膀飛走了。)
We ordered some fried chicken wings.
(我們點了一些炸雞翅。)

wire(n.)金屬線、電線
wireless(adj.)無線的
electric wire 電線
wire fence 鐵絲網
Don't touch that electric wire.
(別碰那條電線。)
The wire connects the speaker to the computer.
(這條線把喇叭連到電腦上。)

within(prep./adv.)在……之內
(無詞性變化)
within a week 一週內
within reach 伸手可及
Please reply within three days.
(請在三天內回覆。)
The school is within walking distance.
(學校在步行可到的距離內。)

wolf(n.)狼
wolves(n.)狼(複數)
a pack of wolves 一群狼
lone wolf 獨來獨往的人
The wolf howled at the moon.
(那隻狼對著月亮嚎叫。)
Wolves usually hunt in groups.
(狼通常成群獵食。)

wonder(v./n.)想知道、納悶、驚奇、奇蹟
wonderful(adj.)極好的
no wonder 難怪
I wonder if 我想知道是否
I wonder why he is late.
(我想知道他為什麼遲到。)
No wonder you are tired; you slept so late.
(難怪你很累，你那麼晚睡。)

wood(n.)木頭、木材、woods(n.)樹林、森林
wooden(adj.)木製的
made of wood 木製的
in the woods 在樹林裡
This table is made of wood.
(這張桌子是木頭做的。)
We went for a walk in the woods.
(我們去樹林裡散步。)

wooden(adj.)木製的、呆板的
wood(n.)木頭
wooden box 木箱
wooden floor 木地板
Grandpa made me a wooden toy.
(爺爺做了一個木頭玩具給我。)
The house has a wooden floor.
(這間房子是木地板。)

wool(n.)羊毛、毛線
woolen(adj.)羊毛製的
wool sweater 羊毛毛衣
ball of wool 毛線球
This sweater is made of wool.
(這件毛衣是羊毛做的。)
Grandma knitted a scarf with red wool.
(奶奶用紅色毛線織了一條圍巾。)

workbook(n.)練習簿、作業簿
(無詞性變化)
English workbook 英文習作
finish the workbook 完成習作
Please do page ten in your workbook.
(請寫你習作的第十頁。)
I forgot to bring my math workbook.
(我忘了帶數學習作。)

worm(n./v.)蟲、蠕蟲、蠕行
(無詞性變化)
early bird catches the worm 早起的鳥兒有蟲吃
worm one's way 慢慢擠進
The bird caught a worm.
(那隻鳥抓到一隻蟲。)
There are many worms in the soil after rain.
(下雨後土裡有很多蟲。)

worse(adj./adv./n.)更壞的、更糟地、更糟的事
worsen(v.)惡化
get worse 變得更糟
worse than 比……更糟
The weather is getting worse.
(天氣愈來愈糟了。)
My cold is worse than yesterday.
(我的感冒比昨天更嚴重。)

worst(adj./adv./n.)最壞的、最糟地、最壞的情況
(無詞性變化)
at worst 在最壞的情況下
the worst day 最糟的一天
Today was the worst day of my life.
(今天是我人生中最糟的一天。)
Prepare for the worst and hope for the best.
(做最壞的打算，抱最好的希望。)

worth(adj./n.)值得的、價值
worthy(adj.)值得的
worthless(adj.)無價值的
be worth it 值得
worth a visit 值得一遊
This movie is worth watching.
(這部電影值得一看。)
The trip was long, but it was worth it.
(旅程很長，但很值得。)

wound(n./v.)傷口、使受傷
wounded(adj.)受傷的
deep wound 很深的傷口
heal a wound 治癒傷口
The nurse cleaned the wound on his leg.
(護理師清理了他腿上的傷口。)
Two soldiers were wounded in the fight.
(兩名士兵在戰鬥中受傷。)

yam(n.)山藥、番薯
(無詞性變化)
sweet yam 甜番薯
yam soup 山藥湯
My grandma cooked yam soup for us.
(奶奶為我們煮了山藥湯。)
Roasted yams are popular in winter.
(烤番薯在冬天很受歡迎。)

youth(n.)青春、年輕時代、年輕人
young(adj.)年輕的
youthful(adj.)年輕的、有朝氣的
in one's youth 在年輕時
youth hostel 青年旅館
He was a good swimmer in his youth.
(他年輕時是游泳好手。)
The program is designed for local youth.
(這個計畫是為當地年輕人設計的。)

zebra(n.)斑馬
(無詞性變化)
zebra crossing 斑馬線
a herd of zebras 一群斑馬
Zebras have black and white stripes.
(斑馬有黑白相間的條紋。)
Always cross the road at the zebra crossing.
(過馬路一定要走斑馬線。)
